C0448.title: Guizhou Bainian Yuanzhi Liquor Falsified Inventory Tax Evasion Case
C0448.summary: Guizhou Bainian Yuanzhi Liquor Co., Ltd. concealed income by fabricating inventory records and conducting low-price sales through affiliated enterprises, resulting in a cumulative underpayment of taxes totaling 8.6983 million yuan. The company used false inventory to disguise its actual operating conditions for tax evasion purposes.
